title: Jubilant Broiled British Chicken Bowl
description: A garlicky, turmeric‑flavored chicken bowl that feels light yet hearty, perfect for an afternoon tea setting.
instructions: Preheat oven broiler to high and place fondue pot on the middle rack.
In a bowl combine olive oil, turmeric, minced garlic, lemon juice, smoked paprika, sea salt and black pepper to make a paste.
Coat chicken breasts evenly with the paste and let them marinate for 10 minutes.
Place marinated chicken in the fondue pot and broil for 6 to 7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Remove from oven and let rest for 3 minutes before slicing into strips.
Serve sliced chicken in the fondue pot over a bed of parsley, optionally accompanied by steamed greens.
